evaluation: Per-case and aggregate A/P Dice, foreground Dice, missed/extra/swapped voxels, mean surface distance, HD95; deltas versus fresh Dice+bands and matched factor contrasts. Single fold/seed exploratory screen, no confirmatory claim.

calibration.basis: Training-only final-logit gradient RMS, sequential combined-base calibration

geometry_policy: Annotation-derived native 1 mm outer boundaries. Original controls unchanged. Independent scales use oriented crossings; whole intervening side segments must remain in class and native FOV. Separate-support arms retain valid sides independently. Common-support arms match oriented faces. Endpoint steps are measured from immediate inside/outside voxel centers; actual separation is inside_steps + outside_steps + 1 mm.
calibration_policy: Verified shared epoch-5 Dice-only prefix. Bands calibrated median logit-gradient RMS 0.1 and p95 <= 0.5 relative to Dice. Extras jointly calibrated at 0.1 relative to Dice+bands, except explicit 0.05/0.15 budget arms; fixed p95 cap 0.5. Training-only calibration on all 10 cases; coefficients fixed, original epoch6-10 ramp.

loss_definitions.pair: Independent Brier targets, side-specific scale mixtures, side mass, endpoint eligibility/offsets and reductions. Alternate BCE, power, Huber, probability-error dead-zone and 50/50 mean/top-tail penalties.
loss_definitions.bands: Canonical original or physical regional BCE/Brier. Optional predeclared shell weights, side balance, exponential distance decay, class-balanced surface association or top-tail emphasis.
loss_definitions.surface: Existing distance/Chamfer losses or squared local foreground-fraction mismatch in 3/5-voxel boxes, valid-FOV normalized within 3 mm of annotated boundary. Local volume can cancel opposite errors; standalone endpoints remain active.

storage_budget: Retain three controls and current top five best checkpoints, one active resume checkpoint, and common warmup. Verify all completed artifacts before retiring other new-run checkpoints. Keep every prediction, metric, history, config, source and calibration. No deletion from previous campaigns.
interpretation: Exploratory post-hoc follow-up: 189 predeclared arms, one fold/seed, 10 training and 52 validation cases. Hypotheses informed by prior validation errors; same validation set is development data. Report every result and paired differences; independent seed/fold confirmation required. No automatic outcome-based additions.
